name: 512KB Club

name: 250KB Club

name: 1MB Club
notable: Collection of pages under 1 MB; the loosest budget of the three clubs, so it admits sites with real imagery and interaction.

name: 1.44MB Webring

name: Marginalia Search

name: Marginalia Explore
notable: Explore view shows a grid of 24 random indexed sites as screenshots with only domain names, each with a 'show results similar to this website' link.
mechanic: The visitor refreshes or clicks 'similar to this website', causing the grid to reload with random or look-alike sites, which reveals neighbouring clusters of the independent web.

name: marginalia.nu
notable: Author's home page for the Marginalia project: a plain portal offering the search engine, an encyclopedia and a personal website as its three doors.

name: Kagi Small Web
notable: Feed of personal blogs, independent YouTube channels and webcomics from genuine humans, positioned as a way to discover the small web.

name: blogs.hn
notable: A tiny tech blog directory.

name: Ye Olde Blogroll
notable: Directory of blogs with the tagline 'Because blogs are the soul of the web'.

name: ooh.directory

name: Lieu

name: Search My Site

name: IndieWeb

name: Hotline Webring

name: webri.ng
notable: Platform for hosting webrings without having to manage your own infrastructure.

name: geekring.net

name: Catweb webring

name: Webring List (brisray)

name: List of active Webrings 2025 (Tuffy)

name: pysj.party

name: Fediring

name: XXIIVV: journal

name: Permacomputing 101 (Hundred Rabbits)

name: Pino (Hundred Rabbits)

name: permacomputing.net

name: Merveilles

name: Low-tech Magazine: About

name: NO TECH MAGAZINE

name: Gwern.net: Sidenotes In Web Design
